title: Good overall design, just a smidgeon too narrow, but.....
text: Good overall design, just a smidgeon too narrow, but...... Nicely designed overall, but just a tad too narrow. This causes soft butter to constantly get all over the inside and the lid; if it were just a little wider much of the mess would not occur. That being said, it is still well worth the price for those looking to keep butter out at room temperature.

product_metadata.title: Standard Butter Dish(Colors May Vary)
description: This convenient butter dish is specially designed to store butter. Made with durable, thick plastic, this butter dish makes a strong and long-lasting addition to your kitchen. Keeps your butter fresh for an optimal period of time.
